import sys

MOD = 1000000007

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    p = int(data[0])
    k = int(data[1])

    if k == 0 or k == 1:
        resp = pow(p, p - 1, MOD)
        if k == 1:
            resp = (resp * p) % MOD
        print(resp)
        return

    seen = [False] * p
    resp = 1
    for i in range(1, p):
        if not seen[i]:
            x = i
            c = 0
            while not seen[x]:
                seen[x] = True
                x = (k * x) % p
                c += 1
            if pow(k, c, p) == 1:
                resp = (resp * p) % MOD
            # else multiply by 1, no change
    print(resp)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
